description: This file implements notification-related services, including listing user notifications, retrieving user preferences, and updating preferences, using SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_notifications(db: Session, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications for a user, optionally filtering unread notifications only, with a limit.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_preferences(db: Session, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches user preferences from the database, returning default preferences if none are set.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] set_preferences(db: Session, user_id: str, notifications_enabled: Optional[bool], language: Optional[str], theme: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates or updates user preferences with provided optional settings using an UPSERT operation.
